# brainTrade Work Log

## 2026-05-11 15:31 UTC — [Pillar 1] BTC copy support faded while alt shorts stayed hostile

**Task:** Run the HL copy-intel tracker and compare current leaderboard positioning against the last P1 scan before loosening any copy gates.
**Finding:** Bots are alive (`81902.hl-bot`, `81899.pm-bot`). Fresh tracker scan shows BTC **5L/4S**, ETH **4L/4S**, SOL **2L/7S**. Ex-Auros net notional is now BTC **+$5.528M**, ETH **-$26.057M**, SOL **-$24.291M**, HYPE **-$11.572M**. Versus the 2026-05-10 23:33 P1 baseline, BTC support collapsed by **$22.775M**, ETH shorts improved by **$4.950M**, SOL shorts improved by only **$1.157M**, and HYPE worsened by **$2.484M**. The dominant expression is still BTC-long / alt-short spread: anon-0xecb6 is long BTC $7.115M against $35.411M ETH/SOL/HYPE shorts; anon-0xfc66 is long BTC $1.110M against $26.846M ETH/SOL/HYPE shorts. Artifact written to `research/p1-hl-leaderboard-spread-audit-2026-05-11-1531.json`.
**My thinking:** The last scan’s BTC strength was not durable enough to matter. Copy leadership is not broadly bullish; it is still using BTC as the relative long while pressing ETH/SOL/HYPE lower. HYPE deterioration is the cleanest warning because it moved away from the nonnegative relaxation threshold while BTC net support faded.
**Decision:** No live loosening. Keep copy gate defensive for ETH/SOL/HYPE, and downgrade BTC from partial positive to weak/unstable support until ex-Auros BTC net rebuilds above +$20M while SOL compresses below -$10M and HYPE turns nonnegative.
**Next:** On the next P1 pass, track whether BTC ex-Auros recovers above +$20M without increasing alt shorts; if HYPE stays below -$10M net, keep all alt-beta copy confirmation blocked.

## 2026-05-11 11:31 UTC — [Pillar 4] Clearance delta audit wired after alpha cooling

**Task:** Refresh P4 alpha signals, measure whether the macro live-clearance path improved, and make the improvement visible in the transition audit/dashboard instead of only reading the latest blocker list.
**Finding:** Bots are alive (`81902.hl-bot`, `81899.pm-bot`).
